_comment: Controls which output columns get generated and how each is computed from the Kaggle CSVs in data/. Toggle 'enabled' to turn a field on/off, or add new fields following the same shape. Each field's 'aggregate' must be one supported by scripts/lib/aggregates.js.

fields.name: Championships
fields.note: Not derivable from the Kaggle box-score dataset; needs a secondary NBA Finals results source. Skipped for this pass.

fields.name: First Season
fields.note: Numeric, gets a real min/max range filter in Ranker. Collapses career gaps (see Years Played for a gap-accurate view).

fields.name: Last Season
fields.note: Numeric, gets a real min/max range filter in Ranker. Collapses career gaps (see Years Played for a gap-accurate view).

fields.name: Years Played
fields.note: Human-readable, e.g. "2001-2005, 2006". Preserves career gaps, but is a string field in Ranker (exact-match pills only, no range filter).

fields.name: Finals Appearances
fields.note: Not derivable from the Kaggle box-score dataset; needs a secondary NBA Finals results source. Skipped for this pass.
